description:
Search the full shadcn.io community registry by keyword across all 7,732 items.
Returns ranked matches with title, description, category, type (block/example/ui/style/hook),
premium flag, and the install command for direct adoption.

category.description: Optional category slug filter (use shadcn_registry_categories to find)

premium.description: If set, restrict to free (false) or premium (true) only

name: shadcn_registry_search
